name: OpenMontage
summary: Open-source, agentic video production system: 12 pipelines and 100+ tools that turn an AI coding assistant into a video studio.
description: An instruction-driven video production platform where the AI agent is the intelligence and Python exists only for tools and persistence. It ships 12 production pipelines, 100+ tools and 700+ agent skill and production-knowledge files for scripting, generation, the Backlot living storyboard, a style system, platform output profiles and production quality gates. Starts from a reference video or a prompt, runs with zero API keys, and works with Claude, Codex, Cursor and Copilot through platform files.
contains: 12 production pipelines, 100+ tools, 700+ agent skill and production-knowledge files
agent-first: YAML manifests and markdown skills drive the pipeline
Python only for tools and persistence
Backlot living storyboard; style system; platform output profiles; quality gates
starts from a reference video; zero-API-key mode included
